maintenance: Authored study records are authoritative; update index commit/path when adding a new inspected snapshot. Existing local catalogs remain separate.

tools.name: decomp.me
tools.license: MIT; historical compilers and dependencies separate
tools.reuse_decision: Learn recipes and feedback UI; optional scratch use. Do not duplicate workbench or replace local proof runners.

tools.name: asm-differ
tools.reuse_decision: Use as a UI/feedback-design reference or optional external viewer; do not use as strict oracle or OMF/MZ/NE proof parser.

tools.name: objdiff
tools.reuse_decision: Highest-value optional out-of-process adapter candidate for Icy Tower COFF/x86 diagnostics; preserve local raw identities and strict acceptance separately.

tools.name: reccmp
tools.reuse_decision: Study/use as a standalone AGPL tool only for a future compatible old-MSVC/PDB project; do not copy/link into ai_decomp and do not use effective match as strict proof.

tools.name: binutils-omf
tools.license: GPL-2.0-or-later for inspected bfd/i386omf.c; repository-wide redistribution requires component audit
tools.reuse_decision: Evaluate only as an invoked, GPL-separated disassembly/symbol diagnostic after corpus parity tests; do not copy or link the parser into ai_decomp.

tools.name: m2c
tools.reuse_decision: Learn from parsed-asm/typed-IR/CFG/context architecture; do not vendor or port before evidence and licensing decision.

tools.name: decomp-permuter
tools.reuse_decision: Consider only a small isolated compatible adapter trial; otherwise reuse exploration concepts, not the proof model.

reuse_decision.decision: Learn from and potentially adapt isolated concepts; do not integrate as an acceptance system or add a production dependency now.
reuse_decision.license_dependency_note: Mizuchi is MIT, but direct reuse would also add Node, Anthropic Agent SDK, objdiff-wasm and m2c/decomp-permuter submodule dependency reviews.
